findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gtm_plan, reply_pace, live_tools · Private data: buyer_targets, channel_plan, video_studio, price_ladder, live_tools, export_workflow · Public sink: gtm_plan, reply_pace, market_picks, country_brief, price_ladder · Destructive: gtm_plan, reply_pace, channel_plan, live_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gtm_plan, reply_pace, live_tools · Private data: buyer_targets, channel_plan, video_studio, price_ladder, live_tools, export_workflow · Public sink: gtm_plan, reply_pace, market_picks, country_brief, price_ladder · Destructive: gtm_plan, reply_pace, channel_plan, live_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
